title: Personal Counter — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Personal Counter solution should meet the objective: Implement increment, decrement, and reset operations. Reject decrement at zero and test the state after each call. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
